purpose: A fresh direct named Generator parks inside the body before its first yield; the supplied temporary Exception survives with no caller CV, then propagates with null Previous.
source:
<?php
function Make61() {
    global $weak;
    $value = new Exception('given61');
    $weak = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Work61Before() {
    try {
        echo 'ENTER|';
        Fiber::suspend('before61');
        echo 'AFTER|';
        yield 'seed61';
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
    }
}
function Run61Before() {
    global $g, $weak;
    echo 'CALL|';
    try {
        $g->throw(Make61());
        echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
    } catch (Throwable $outside) {
        echo 'OUTSIDE|', (int) ($outside === $weak->get()), '|',
             (int) ($outside->getPrevious() === null), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber61';
}
$g = Work61Before();
$f = new Fiber('Run61Before');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'before61'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber61'), '|';
echo 'RELEASE|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: A fresh direct named Generator parks before first yield, then catches the injected temporary Exception and yields a recovery value.
source:
<?php
function Make61() {
    global $weak;
    $value = new Exception('given61');
    $weak = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Work61Recover() {
    global $weak;
    try {
        echo 'ENTER|';
        Fiber::suspend('before61');
        echo 'FIRST|';
        yield 'seed61';
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $weak->get()), '|';
        yield 'after61';
        echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
    }
    return 61;
}
function Run61Recover() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw(Make61());
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 'after61'), '|';
    return 'fiber61';
}
$g = Work61Recover();
$f = new Fiber('Run61Recover');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'before61'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber61'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 61), '|',
     (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $weak);

purpose: Unchanged I60 primed direct named THROW transfer control.
source:
<?php
function Work60Caught() {
    global $given;
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield 'seed60';
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $given), '|';
        $reply = Fiber::suspend('pause60');
        echo 'REPLY|', (int) ($reply === 'go60'), '|';
        yield 'after60';
        echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
    }
    return 60;
}
function Run60Caught() {
    global $g, $given;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw($given);
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 'after60'), '|';
    return 'fiber60';
}
$given = new Exception('given60');
$g = Work60Caught();
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed60'), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run60Caught');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause60'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed60'), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume('go60') === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber60'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 60), '|';
unset($g, $f, $given, $error);
echo 'E';

purpose: An injected Fiber Throwable aborts a fresh Generator before first yield; the original Generator::throw temporary Exception escapes with the injected Throwable as Previous, then releases on caller completion.
source:
<?php
function Make61Review() {
    global $weak;
    $value = new Exception('given61');
    $weak = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Work61Abort() {
    try {
        echo 'ENTER|';
        Fiber::suspend('before61');
        echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        yield 'seed61';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
    }
}
function Run61Abort() {
    global $g, $stop, $weak;
    echo 'CALL|';
    try {
        $g->throw(Make61Review());
        echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
    } catch (Throwable $outside) {
        $original = $weak->get();
        echo 'OUTSIDE|', (int) ($outside === $stop), '|',
             (int) ($original !== null && $outside === $original), '|',
             (int) ($outside->getPrevious() === $stop), '|',
             (int) ($original !== null && $outside->getPrevious() === $original), '|',
             (int) ($outside->getPrevious() === null), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber61';
}
$g = Work61Abort();
$stop = new RuntimeException('stop61');
$f = new Fiber('Run61Abort');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'before61'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'INJECT|', (int) ($f->throw($stop) === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber61'), '|';
echo 'GIVEN-LIVE|', (int) ($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $stop);
echo 'RELEASE|', (int) ($weak->get() === null), '|';
unset($weak);
echo 'E';
